scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the contact assumptions, transformed model, invariant region, reproduction number, threshold theorems, and complete proof of the disease-free theorem; the theorem and proof pages were visually inspected. The 2022 same-model follow-up was inspected at its reproduced deterministic system and threshold summary. The analytic proof is replayed by a bundled symbolic/numerical checker. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The sharp profile is for the deterministic SIHR system exactly at the critical threshold, assumes the source's differentiable contact law and invariant region, and requires positive initial infection for the nonzero algebraic coefficient. It does not treat the stochastic critical case or refit data.

title: Sharp critical relaxation in a population-dependent SIHR epidemic model
